# IPC targets

Every `IpcHandler`: call with `qs -c axiom ipc call <target> <function> [args]`. `enabled` handlers answer only on their target instance (AGENTS.md › UI conventions, Screen targeting). `show` is a qs keyword, so a function named `show` can't be called.


## appLauncher

`components/surfaces/launcher/Launcher.qml` · enabled: `ShellManager.isTarget(root.screen, LauncherConfig.monitors)`
- `toggle(): void`
- `open(): void`
- `close(): void`
- `search(text: string): void`
